_meta.title: The Model T — biomeOS Dashboard, Levers, Wheels

henry_ford_analogy.model_t: Ford didn't invent the car. He made it ACCESSIBLE. Assembly line. Standardized parts. Anyone could have one.
henry_ford_analogy.gaia_model_t: biomeOS doesn't invent sovereign computing. It makes it ACCESSIBLE. Standardized primals. Reproducible deploy. Anyone can run the organism.
henry_ford_analogy.assembly_line: The 14 primals ARE the assembly line stations. Each does ONE thing. Together they build the car.
henry_ford_analogy.steering_wheel: The dashboard — what the DRIVER sees and touches
henry_ford_analogy.key_insight: Ford's genius wasn't the engine. It was the INTERFACE between human and machine.

steamos_die_interface.the_die: The die is where silicon meets software. biomeOS's die interface is the Layer 0: toadStool (WHERE) + coralReef (HOW) + barraCuda (MATH). RTX 5090 = the die.

dashboard.description: What the driver sees. The instrument cluster of the organism.

speedometer.what: Inference speed — tokens per second across all models

fuel_gauge.what: GPU VRAM usage — how much compute capacity remains

temperature.what: GPU temp / system temp — organism body temperature

oil_pressure.meaning: High pressure = under attack. Low = calm.

nav_screen.shows: now.json, alive stats, laws, endpoints, organism counts

rear_view.shows: Last 10 commits, file changes, push status

map.what: LAN topology — who's alive on the network

levers.description: What the driver PULLS to make things happen. Direct controls.

throttle.what: Model selection — which Luna models are active

brake.what: Kill a primal — stop a process

clutch.what: Switch modes — TCP vs socket, debug vs production

gear_shift.what: Temperature routing — hot models vs cold models
gear_shift.how: cortex.pi temperature parameter, arena.pi tier selection

turn_signal.what: Publish/radiate — announce to the old web
turn_signal.how: RSS feed update, REEDIT post, Reddit draft

emergency_brake.what: Water lock CLOSE — cut all external connections
emergency_brake.when: Under attack, data leak suspected, maintenance

wheels.description: Where the rubber meets the road. The 4 contact points with reality.

front_left.what: LAN — local network, direct device communication

front_right.what: WAN — internet-facing, port forwards through router

rear_right.what: RSS — the old web, syndication, mouth of the organism
rear_right.traction: Passive reach, anyone with a reader can subscribe

automations.description: The things that happen WITHOUT the driver. The cruise control. The ABS. The power steering.

lane_assist.what: cortex.pi routing — models automatically selected by temperature
